body_html:
I am working with @sadike25 to launch the  Global Open Initiative in Ghana in order to  develop #digitalliteracies skills while creating a community engaged in the praxis of #OpenPedagogy.

We want a site where school leaders curate OER while developing their personal cyber infastructure. 

We need your help. We need to raise $110 annually to launch the program,

Budget

Shared hosting, A domain and 10 gigs $50 from Reclaim Hosting

Mastodon Shared Hosting, Monthy hosting $5 for $60 ayear

Goals

We will create a shared site to curate and display community efforts. Every participant in the program, we have dozens already, will be given a subdomain and a blogging platform.

While we would like to be able to afford giving every participant a domain and shared hosting package we can not afford that right now and do not have the time for the sustained fundraising it would take to raise $1,400 to give everyone a website.

Timeline

We will launch the effort by May. Sadike will be joining us for IndieWebCamp Online and then remotely for IndieWebCamp New Haven. 

Donate Now

Hard to believe we can bring the web to this many people for just over $100 dollars. If you can skip your TDouble Ristretto Venti Half-Soy Nonfat Decaf Organic Blend (made with coffee from Ghana actually) we can help unleash the power of OER in Ghana.

Just send $5-10 using paypal tojgregmcverry@gmail.com (make sure to select friends and family so you aren't charged fees).
